title: What the AI Industry Got Wrong About Public Backlash
title_cn: 人工智能行业在公众强烈反对方面犯了什么错误
summary:
Even those within the AI industry have been very anxious about the technology. Worries about its potential to create destabilizing job losses, or rogue AI that could lead to human extinction. But for all their anxiety, they missed the thing that's become the most publicly salient: how upset people would be about data centers. Data center construction has been happening for a long time, and it used to be relatively uncontroversial. In fact, cities and states would often design their tax code to incentivize data center construction. On this episode, we speak with independent writer and Substacker Jasmine Sun, who recently traveled to Wisconsin and Michigan to report about the communities and activists trying to stop development, what the pushback is really all about and what future developers will have to do in order to be welcomed in.

title: China, Indonesia Agree on Closer Defense Ties in High-Level Talks in Jakarta
title_cn: 中国和印度尼西亚在雅加达高层会谈中同意加强防务关系
summary: China and Indonesia agreed to deepen their military, maritime and technology cooperation in high-level talks in Jakarta on Friday, underscoring Beijing’s growing regional reach at a time of renewed uncertainty over US security commitments in Asia.

title: Our Town Chapter 3: One Little Bacon-Wrapped Sausage (Podcast)
title_cn: 我们的小镇第 3 章：一根培根包裹的小香肠（播客）
summary: Backers of the venture are big fans of a town in Idaho where a preacher with a flamethrower tells our reporters how much he hates feminism.

title: Analysis of Germany's Economic Challenges, Regional Elections
title_cn: 德国经济挑战、地区选举分析
summary: The German economy is facing a squeeze on many sides: higher energy prices, tariffs from the US, increased competition from China. Meanwhile, the far-right Alternative for Germany party is expected to make major gains in upcoming regional elections. Bloomberg's Christoph Rauwald and Michael Nienaber report. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Risks China Blowback With Plan to Choke Iran’s Economy
title_cn: 特朗普计划扼杀伊朗经济，面临中国反击的风险
summary: When Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent vowed to ramp up pressure on Iran by targeting its economic partners, he echoed former President George W. Bush’s warning to US allies after the Sept. 11 attacks.

title: Hamid Karzai on Life Under the Taliban
title_cn: 哈米德·卡尔扎伊谈塔利班统治下的生活
summary: Former Afghanistan president Hamid Karzai talks to Mishal Husain about regime-change wars, conflict with Pakistan and why he's still talking to the Taliban. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US, Japan, South Korea Urge North Korea to Halt ‘Provocations’
title_cn: 美日韩敦促朝鲜停止“挑衅”
summary: The US, Japan and South Korea held a three-way call to coordinate their response to North Korea’s barrage of short-range ballistic missiles, after Pyongyang dismissed President Donald Trump’s overtures to revive dialogue with leader Kim Jong Un.
